tool_activity.command: /bin/bash -c "pwd && printf '%s\\n' '--- files ---' && rg --files -g '*' -g '"'!__pycache__'"' && printf '%s\\n' '--- TASK.md ---' && sed -n '1,240p' TASK.md && printf '%s\\n' '--- candidate.py ---' && sed -n '1,260p' candidate.py && printf '%s\\n' '--- materials files ---' && rg --files materials && for f in "'$(rg --files materials); do printf '"'%s\\n' \"--- "'$f ---"; sed -n '"'1,260p' \""'$f"; done'

/bin/bash -c "sed -n '1170,1235p' materials/core.py && sed -n '1980,2070p' materials/core.py && sed -n '1180,1210p' materials/extra/cuda/libdevice.py && sed -n '2880,2925p' materials/core.py && sed -n '3235,3335p' materials/core.py"

/bin/bash -c "rg -n \"def (exp|fast_exp|tanh|div|rcp)\" materials/extra/cuda/libdevice.py && sed -n '1130,1210p' materials/extra/cuda/libdevice.py && rg -n \"def sigmoid|sigmoid\\(\" materials/core.py materials/standard.py"
/bin/bash -c "sed -n '1,220p' candidate.py && printf '%s\\n' '--- diff-like checks ---' && wc -l candidate.py && rg -n \"stride|m,|n,|k,|tanh|exp\" candidate.py"

reason: Specialized the fused Triton kernel for the fixed contiguous 512x512 profile, removing runtime stride metadata and using libdevice tanh.
